item.title: Morning Weather for Sunday, August 30
item.description: Good morning! It's the weekend. No school today! Let's find out what the weather is like on this Sunday, August 30. Sunday. A slow and cosy sort of day. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be stormy with thunder and hail. The high will be 32 degrees, and the low will be 27 degrees. The chance of rain is 95 percent. Pack your umbrella and your wellies! Take your raincoat with you. Splashing is allowed! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be thundery, with a high of 33 degrees. Here's a question: if you could invent a new weather, what would it be like? And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
